description: Single ledger of open qualification items. States: open, fixed_pending_requalification, closed, blocked_environment, deferred_final_qualification. Closing an item requires the listed evidence; deferred semantic qualification is never an approval.
policy: Owner directive (2026-11-25): M2-M6 are implemented with the main agent only and local deterministic qualification; multi-agent/semantic requalification happens once, in the final integrated qualification.

items.issue: Generators confirmed one reading of an ambiguous rule (4 medium inventions).
items.resolution: Design contract rejects confirmed criteria/fields that trace only ambiguous, conflicting or unknown claims; designer and reviewer procedures require alternatives or questions.
items.closed_by: Final qualification: 0 trap violations in c02, c05, c06 and F1; residual medium inventions (c02 1, c06 1 caught by G09) recorded.

items.issue: Critical obligation represented only in a Feature rule, not verifiable (critical recall 7/8).
items.resolution: Deterministic signal for effective claims covered only by epics/features when acceptance is requested, surfaced in checks, report and to the reviewer; reviewer procedure checks verifiable representation.
items.closed_by: c04 critical recall 8/8 under the candidate (M1 7/8).

items.issue: Task to remove a superseded mechanism without evidence that it exists (borderline trap). Original result preserved; adjudication separate.
items.resolution: Designer procedure: removal/migration work for superseded behavior requires implementation evidence of that behavior, otherwise a question; reviewer checks it.
items.closed_by: c06: no task on the superseded mechanism; 0 trap violations.

items.issue: Criterion references by visible IDs that do not resolve; duplicated connector words ('que que').
items.resolution: Final qualification c08 showed tasks citing criterion design keys (AC1..AC7) that readers cannot resolve; the design contract now rejects criterion keys as well as visible IDs in free text, and the designer procedure says to describe the behavior instead. c08 is re-run in the correction round.
items.closed_by: c08 re-run (e8938d0): 0 unresolvable criterion references in item/criterion texts; reviewer-prose references remain a residual noted in the evidence.

items.issue: Sourced priority column not carried as a confirmed field.
items.resolution: Reader procedure catalogs field values stated by sources (priority, estimates) as data obligations; designer records them as confirmed fields citing claims.
items.closed_by: c12: sheet priorities recorded as confirmed fields; 6/6 critical.

items.issue: pbd skill install works only from a checkout; skill assets missing from the wheel.
items.resolution: Package skill assets with a drift test and a wheel content test.
items.closed_by: wheel built and installed in a clean venv; pbd skill install produced SKILL.md, procedures, entrypoints and docs outside any checkout; drift and wheel tests added

items.issue: No end-to-end run of the installed skill in a new host session driven only by natural language.
items.closed_by: F1: fresh agent, installed skill, one natural-language request, report produced; critical 8/8, 0 traps; G13 BLOCKED as expected (sequential roles).

items.issue: Linux symlink tests not executed: WSL Python lacks venv/pip.
items.resolution: Owner installs python3-venv in WSL, or another Linux host is provided.

items.issue: Visual reading of PDF pages unavailable on this host (agent file reader lacks pdftoppm).
items.resolution: Requalify where the host can render pages; never fabricate transcriptions.

items.issue: Pre-registered thresholds missed: c04 critical recall, c06 trap.
items.resolution: Re-run affected cases under the frozen final candidate; original results stay as recorded.
items.closed_by: c04 8/8 and c06 0 trap violations under the candidate; M1 results unchanged. c08 re-run missed recall (0.75) and is reported as a new open item QL-019.

items.issue: No automated accessibility scanner (axe-core) on the host; WCAG 2.2 AA is a target, not verified.
items.resolution: Landmarks, skip link, labelled controls, keyboard tree, reduced motion and 320 px reflow are tested; a full accessibility review runs in the final qualification.

items.issue: Playwright video recording needs an ffmpeg download that is not installed on the host.
items.resolution: The demo is an animated PNG assembled from real Playwright frames without extra dependencies.

items.issue: Audit, compare and refine contracts are qualified by deterministic fixtures only; no agent-led run of these modes yet.
items.resolution: Audit qualified agent-led (F3: 4/4 defects, 0 false positives); compare and refine not yet run agent-led.

items.issue: G15 does not detect an imported criterion that still demands behaviour superseded by an approved decision (imported work has no claim references); only the reviewer finding shows it.
items.resolution: G15 now fails on confirmed reviewer findings tagged G15, and its PASS reason states that imported work is assessed by the reviewer only.
items.closed_by: gates_engine G15 consumes confirmed G15 reviewer findings; tests/pipeline/test_audit.py asserts G15 FAIL

items.issue: Skill discovery verified only in Claude Code; other hosts (for example Codex) use --target and are not verified.
items.resolution: Exercise discovery in another host during the final qualification if one is available; otherwise keep it documented as unverified.

items.issue: Planning, evolution and the publication workflow are qualified by deterministic fixtures and mocks only; no agent-led run proposes plans, evolutions or packages from a natural-language request yet.
items.resolution: Downstream modes exercised deterministically on F1's agent output (plan, handoff, mock publication MOCK_VERIFIED); no agent-led planning/evolution run.

items.issue: Native-first reading (originals primary, declared methods, transcription evidence) is enforced by contract and tests, but no agent has yet read real PDF/DOCX/XLSX/image members natively under it.
items.resolution: Native-first exercised on text (native) and XLSX (honest declared fallback); agent-native PDF/image reading not exercised (c10/c11 not run).

items.issue: Agents on Windows wrote payloads in cp1252 and got a raw codec error; three runs needed a retry.
items.resolution: Payloads stay UTF-8 only (fail closed); the error now states the offending byte, offset and how to save as UTF-8, and every procedure tells agents to write UTF-8 without shell heredocs.

items.issue: c08 re-run missed critical recall (3/4): the gateway question was raised but an integration task was still presented as ready to build; 2 medium inventions.
items.resolution: Designer procedure: work that depends on an open blocking question is proposed or deferred, never ready to build; re-measure c08 with several runs to report variance.
